facts.fact: Revised, supersedes F612 and F525's day-35 council date: the bond ends on day 35 at the Meadow Cairn; Shilak's thaw, and the council at the Shilak Cairn, come on day 56, three weeks to the day later, consistent with F435; the queen arrives three days after.
Meera counts Harish as going in sixty-one winters back, Book 2's winter.
